name: Finance / Transactions Pack
description: Industry context for financial transaction ledgers — payments, transfers, and account activity.

vocabulary.definition: A single financial movement (payment, transfer, charge, refund)
The account a transaction is posted against

canonical_roles.revenue_amount: the monetary amount of a transaction
canonical_roles.transaction_status: the transaction outcome state (success / failed / pending)
canonical_roles.transaction_date: the date the transaction was posted
canonical_roles.transaction_type: the transaction category (debit / credit / payment / refund)

notes: Never expose account numbers, SSN, or full name in aggregate outputs
All data access must be read-only
Treat all monetary aggregates as sensitive; avoid row-level exposure of individual transactions beyond the row cap
